title: Auto Anticipation & Bounce (Final Fix)
description: Robust parsing and calculation without results access in UI step.

steps.args: var raw = results[0]; if(!raw) throw new Error('No response'); var data = JSON.parse(raw); var kf = data.keyframes; if(!kf) throw new Error('No keyframes'); var animId = ''; var keys = []; for(var id in kf){ animId=id; keys=keys.concat(kf[id]); } if(!animId) throw new Error('No anim ID'); setVar('animId', animId); setVar('keys', keys);
steps.label: 2. Parse Data

steps.args: var keys = vars.keys; var animId = vars.animId; var antF = parseFloat(vars.antF)||5; var antS = parseFloat(vars.antS)||0.3; var bounF = parseFloat(vars.bounF)||5; var bounS = parseFloat(vars.bounS)||0.15; var interp = vars.interp||'cubic'; var groups = {}; keys.forEach(function(k){ var gid = k.objectId+'_'+k.propertyKey; if(!groups[gid]) groups[gid]=[]; groups[gid].push(k); }); var newKeys = []; for(var gid in groups){ var g = groups[gid]; g.sort(function(a,b){return a.frame-b.frame;}); if(g.length<2) continue; var s=g[0]; var e=g[g.length-1]; var delta = e.value - s.value; newKeys.push({objectId:s.objectId, propertyKey:s.propertyKey, frame:Math.round(s.frame-antF), value:s.value-(delta*antS), interpolationType:interp}); newKeys.push({objectId:s.objectId, propertyKey:s.propertyKey, frame:Math.round(e.frame+bounF), value:e.value+(delta*bounS), interpolationType:interp}); newKeys.push({objectId:s.objectId, propertyKey:s.propertyKey, frame:Math.round(e.frame+bounF*2), value:e.value, interpolationType:interp}); } if(newKeys.length===0) throw new Error('Need 2+ keys per property'); setVar('newKeys', newKeys); setVar('animId', animId);
steps.label: 4. Calculate (No Results Access)
